articles.title: Supreme Court Says: Lisa Cook Keeps Her Fed Job — For Now!
articles.summary: The Supreme Court made a surprise move: it let Lisa Cook, the first Black woman on the Fed Board, stay in her job while her case goes through court. President Trump tried to fire her, but the court said the Fed is special — its members can't be fired just because the president wants to.

articles.title: Supreme Court Gives Trump a Big Win: He Can Fire Watchdog Agency Leaders!
articles.summary: In a huge 6-3 decision, the Supreme Court said President Trump can fire leaders of independent agencies like the FTC without a reason. This overturns a 91-year-old rule that protected those jobs. Now, the president has way more control over agencies that watch over big companies and protect consumers.

articles.title: Israeli Attacks Force Families to Flee in Southern Syria — Turkey Says It's Against the Law
articles.summary: Israeli soldiers fired shells near homes in a village in southern Syria, forcing families to run away in the middle of the night. The attack happened in Abdin village. Turkey and Syria both say Israel broke international law. Israel says it was fighting "terrorists," but didn't give proof.
